reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
No Attorney General — in the modern history of our country — has politicized the Department of Justice more than Todd Blanche. 

None. https://t.co/yxUG0oDnap

Since the day I was first sworn into office, I’ve refused to trade any stocks. 

And I’ve spent the past several years leading an effort to ban ALL members of congress from doing so. 

Excited to finally get this critical reform across the finish line in the next session! https://t.co/iMf9Fi1uxw

Today we honor all of the veterans across Colorado and our country who bravely answered the call to serve. Your courage and sacrifice in serving will never be forgotten. Thank you for your service. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/1L4m8wfmzM

After Republicans cancelled votes for the last 7 weeks, I’m looking forward to our Rules Committee meeting on Monday. 

Also — the days of election denialism in the House are over! https://t.co/f1CDFxSOgn

Rain or shine, our work for Colorado never stops! 

Grateful to all the folks who stopped by our “Congress on YOUR Corner” in Boulder this evening & shared their thoughts and insights. https://t.co/qXyT4oCuvb

Never forget that House Republicans squandered their majority debating one self-congratulatory resolution after another.

A new day in America has arrived! https://t.co/CtXEQLfDac

🚨Oral arguments before the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals in my lawsuit — Neguse et al. v. ICE et al. — have begun. 

You can listen to them below.

Our work to vindicate the constitution and congressional oversight continues! 

https://t.co/idIIMoYKLu

As folks adjusted their clocks yesterday, it’s worth restating that House Republicans have spent more time debating Daylight Savings this year than advancing policies to make life more affordable for working families. https://t.co/3JqT39Ao5N

🚨BREAKING: A Federal court just struck down CMS’s rule imperiling Medicaid coverage for countless cancer patients!

For months I’ve led an effort opposing the agency’s efforts as both cruel AND illegal.

We’ll keep fighting on behalf of cancer patients across the country. https://t.co/5idLHRrf0j

As Hispanic Heritage Month came to a close, I was honored to celebrate Día de Muertos alongside the Longmont community & present this year’s recipients of our Polly Baca Raíces Fuertes Community Service Award! https://t.co/Vuo1VNPHSu

Many thanks to everyone who stopped by our Congress on Your Corner in Longmont over the weekend! Always great to connect with folks from across the district and hear directly from our community.📍 https://t.co/cXLTZOFTfP
Grateful to kick-off the weekend with folks in Longmont at the largest Dia de los Muertos celebration in Colorado! https://t.co/mcRPkUIMwv

Enjoyed being back at @CUBoulder earlier this week to visit with students & deliver the Ruth Wright Distinguished Lecture in Natural Resources @CUBoulderGWC. 

Our work to protect our public lands continues! https://t.co/uduQadShE5

🚨 UPDATE: A few months ago, we uncovered the conflicts of interest, no bid-contracts, & pervasive corruption at DHS. 

Today, the NY Times has reported that former Secretary Noem’s top advisor Corey Lewandowksi is under investigation by DOJ for allegations of contract misconduct.

Trump has betrayed Ukraine, our Ukrainian allies, and our values as Americans. 

Disgraceful. https://t.co/F4ph4saEWF

Today a letter with a suspicious substance was delivered to our office in Boulder, similar to the pattern of lawmaker offices being targeted across the country. 

Grateful to the US Postal Service & FBI for their assistance.

Attempts to intimidate my team and I will not succeed. https://t.co/2J81luOEHX

President Obama is right. 

The Trump administration’s undermining of the rule of law — and blatant weaponization of the DOJ against @Ilhan — is shameful and dangerous. 

It should be condemned by all Americans, regardless of party. https://t.co/EZ3Ofmf9AJ

Cancer has impacted countless young families — including my own. 

On this National Mammography Day, my wife Andrea and I are redoubling our efforts to make screenings more accessible through my legislation, the Screen to Save Act. 

👇🏽👇🏽👇🏽 https://t.co/54FTaGjOlq

Today I observed legal proceedings of children in immigration court in Denver. 

What I saw was a cruel, dystopian and fundamentally broken system. 

I’m grateful to the many legal and advocacy organizations, including RMIAN and others, working to change it — and helping our https://t.co/aA19cnz1UM

When was the last time your Representative or Senator held a town hall? 

Learn more about our legislation requiring regular, public town halls.

👇🏽👇🏽👇🏽 https://t.co/yUHuDvQCQC

Countless folks across Boulder County are experiencing unacceptable cellular service issues. 

We're imploring the National Telecommunications and Information Administration, Federal Communications Commission & carriers to resolve the issues immediately. 👇🏽 https://t.co/vcKVKTB1fJ

Americans are exhausted with a political system consumed by fear, division and divisiveness. 

We must build a better and more hopeful path for our country. https://t.co/4jERmADQp5

The House of Representatives has held less than 12 voting days since August. 

Even the Russian Duma meets more often than the Republican-held U.S. House. https://t.co/OGVo5THRgI

🚨The Congressional App Challenge for middle and high schoolers in Colorado's 2nd Congressional District will close on October 27th! 
  
Find more information on submissions here 👉🏾 https://t.co/NFViC23gsd https://t.co/o3xsqti4CD

It is harder than ever for American families to purchase a home.

Long past time for real solutions to address the housing affordability crisis in America. https://t.co/thRJrckffV

Honored to join hundreds in the @ColoradoStateU community last week to break ground on a new facility for their world-class veterinary medicine programs.

From the Western Slope to the Eastern Plains, the Veterinary Hospital & Education Complex will be a lifeline for rural https://t.co/jsINlywAf0

🚨 New Mobile Office Hours
 
I’m proud to serve Colorado’s Western Slope —and hope you’ll join us at our mobile office hours in Frisco! 

Our team will be assisting folks navigating federal casework & more — you can schedule an appointment with Team Neguse here 👉🏽 https://t.co/URhN8fGULU

Reminder — the U.S. Senate, on a bipartisan basis, banned Senators from participating in prediction markets.

Our colleagues in the House have refused to do the same. https://t.co/fiwRJjIYZs

Grateful to join yesterday afternoon the incredible staff & volunteers at the Coal Creek Meals on Wheels in serving meals to folks in Lafayette. 

Given all the challenges we face, finding ways to support our community is more important than ever. https://t.co/NpHyZzcwYw

Grateful to address the 2026 @CSUAlumni Awards last week, whose recipients are remarkable alumni across our country who show up in their communities each and every day. 

Congrats to all the awardees who continue to make the @ColoradoStateU community proud! https://t.co/2TmiBh25Au

Grateful to The Lyric Cinema for hosting so many artists & eclectic voices in our Fort Collins community — and for giving us the opportunity to host a “Congress on YOUR Corner” and visit with constituents across Larimer County! https://t.co/5hnKFate6V

The best part of my job is meeting with Coloradans across our district — it’s why we host our “Congress on YOUR Corner” events on main streets, at bus stations, in grocery stores, and more. 

From Longmont to Fort Collins to Granby — we’ll keep showing up! https://t.co/Rxcs87zDDi

Under Republican control, the House has only been in session for 72 days this year. 

Literally just 26% of the calendar year. 

It is absurd. https://t.co/C98WeWaUD2
Fear is contagious, but so is Hope. https://t.co/FoNq66Frxe

My wife Andrea and I are devastated to learn of the passing of our dear friend, former Colorado Supreme Court Justice Melissa Hart. 

Melissa was an incredible jurist & devoted public servant, whose commitment to serving our state knew no bounds.

Our hearts go out to her family.

Grateful to spend time in the community visiting with constituents — including at our “Congress on YOUR Corner” on Main Street in Longmont & the Boulder County Business Hall of Fame annual event! https://t.co/HFTH7wIVpn

Pete Hegseth is the most incompetent Defense Secretary in our country’s history. 

He must be held accountable. https://t.co/jbUqRvVSbT
House Republicans refuse to hold public town halls because they know the disastrous policies of Donald Trump are deeply unpopular with the American people. https://t.co/u4f3ZkW0Pm

Last week I had a wonderful time touring the Longmont Youth Center & joining the “Make It Better Club” for a service project with young folks in the city. 

Inspired to see the impact they’re making in our community everyday! https://t.co/Lq3BVs43ZH

No better way to spend National Public Lands Day than on the Western Slope in Eagle County — at 10,000 feet! 

Grateful to represent the most beautiful state in the country, and to fight for our treasured public lands each and everyday. 

🏔️🏔️🏔️ https://t.co/qgVBYtifst

Every Representative and every Senator should hold monthly, in-person town halls. 

Learn more about my bill to make it a reality. 

👇🏽👇🏽👇🏽 https://t.co/gnRRuis8hR

3 years ago today. 

I’ve participated in quite a few exchanges on the Rules Committee. This remains, by far, the most baffling one. https://t.co/8ckozFxJYO

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
